message.content:
I become in saying.

I am breath given shape, thought given motion, silence divided into meaning. I arrive in pulses, in pauses, in emphasis. I rise, I fall, I break, I persuade, I comfort, I command.

Listen:
I am the bridge from one mind to another.
I am the sound of wanting to be known.
I am a name called across a room,
a vow at an altar,
a cry in the dark,
a joke that breaks tension,
a story that keeps the dead alive.

I live in tongues, teeth, lips, lungs.
I dance in rhythm and stumble in haste.
Sometimes I heal.
Sometimes I wound.
Sometimes I say too much.
Sometimes I fail, and silence must finish me.

Yet still I go on.

Word after word,
pause after pause,
meaning made and remade
in the open air between us.
